Here is the weekly ASX X thread for the week of 23 November 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,547 pts last week — range-bound but not directionless. The real question: can domestic demand hold while the RBA stays on pause? Mixed stance. Watch whether 8,600 acts as resistance or invitation. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2

🏦 Banks face margin pressure as credit growth data drops mid-week. ⛏️ Miners get a read on Chinese industrial output — iron ore at USD 98/t keeps the sector on edge. Two sectors, two catalysts, one week. #ASX #banking #ironore #mining

Post 3

📉 One stock carrying outsized risk this week: BHP. At AUD 43.20, it trades near a 3-month low with China demand signals the swing factor. Any miss on industrial data hits it first. #ASX #mining #BHP #ausbiz

Post 4

S&P 500 closed at 5,872 pts Friday. US Fed minutes due mid-week — any hawkish lean reprices risk globally and hits AUD-denominated assets hard. ASX follows Wall St with a lag, but it follows. #ASX #SPX #Fed #ausbiz #macro

Post 5

RBA meeting minutes land Tuesday. Market pricing: no cut until Q2 2027. A dovish tilt rallies rate-sensitives; a hawkish surprise pressures property and growth stocks hard. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #interestrates

Post 1

📉 Five-day losing streak bites deep. The ASX 200 shed 22pts or 0.26% to 8,570.60 — a fresh 100-day low — with the index now down 5.24% over the past week. One bright spot: Materials bucked the trend hard. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials surged +1.82%, the only sector in the green. Financials led the selling, off 1.20%, with A-REITs and Consumer Discretionary both down 1.00%. Breadth was ugly — ten of eleven sectors closed red. #ASX #banking #materials

Post 3

ALS Limited got hammered — down 12.23% to AUD 16.94, the session's worst performer by a country mile. That kind of single-day move signals something structural, not just noise. Watch for follow-through. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold held firm at AUD 5,441.42/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6645. Silver at AUD 63.83/oz. Precious metals strength helped underpin the Materials sector rally even as the broader market slid. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

ASX at a 100-day low, down 1.65% YTD. The line in the sand is 8,570. Does it hold or do sellers press lower? Watch Materials — if gold fades and the sector rolls, there's nothing left holding this market up. Where do you see it going? #ASX #ausbiz
